title: The ARM Scalable Vector Extension
version: IEEE Micro 37(2), pp. 26–39, doi:10.1109/MM.2017.35; arXiv:1803.06185v1 author manuscript deposited March 2018

passages.note: The designers define the 128-to-2048-bit range in 128-bit steps and explain how the programming model adjusts to vector length. They discuss demand from new Armv8-A markets and barriers to compiler vectorization.
